title: Hexplain codec vector suite manifest
description: One normative vector suite of a media-encoding register concept that carries a hexplain:codecContract: specification/codecs/<LocalName>/vectors/manifest.json. The prose contract is specification/codecs/index.html; tools/codecs/vectors.py is the reference loader and comparator.

codec.description: The IRI of the register concept whose contract this suite is the executable statement of.

suiteVersion.description: Equals the contract's hexplain:vectorSuiteVersion; a change to any vector's expectation raises both.

sources.description: Where the inputs and expected outputs come from, each with its licence; every vector names one.

unreached.description: A category the contract declares that no input of any known implementation raises, with the reason: a defect of the contract, reported by tools/test_codec_vector_completeness.py until the register withdraws the category.

description.description: Provenance: the library, tool or document that produced the inputs and expectations, with its version, and how any corruption was made.

source.description: The id of one of the suite's sources.

session.description: When true the steps share one codec session (a codec whose contract keeps a session); otherwise every step starts afresh.

inputs.description: Operation-scoped external byte inputs, grouped by kind then reference. They are not codec parameters or format fields. cipherKey, aadPrefix and resource are standard binding kinds. Public test keys only.

params.description: The step's codec parameters by contract key: integers and floats as JSON numbers, booleans, strings, bytes as {"hex": ..} or {"base64": ..}, IRIs as {"iri": ..}, and a list-valued parameter as a JSON array of those. They obey the contract unless the step expects a Description error.

maxOutputBytes.description: The decoded-byte limit the step runs under.

file.description: A file beside the manifest holding the input bytes.

oneOf.description: The output of the step before this one, which must have succeeded: how a round trip through a compressor, whose encoded bytes are the implementation's own, feeds its decode step.

samplesInput.description: Sample data (little-endian, pixel-interleaved) with its geometry, for a SamplesToSamples codec's input.

oneOf.description: The step succeeds; its output is checked only through the vector's expectAll.

order.description: Whether sha256 covers the samples pixel-interleaved (as the implementation lays them out) or rewritten band-sequentially.

category.description: The error category the step raises, in conformance-suite notation. The first four are the categories a contract declares with hexplain:raisesCategory; Description is the category of a step whose parameters the contract rejects (an undeclared name, a missing required parameter, a literal of the wrong type or outside the declared values) and is raised by every codec, so a contract need not declare it.

unpack.description: Before hashing, each row of width samples of bitsPerSample bits (most significant bit first, rows padded to a byte) is widened to one byte per sample.

deinterleave.description: Before hashing, pixel-interleaved samples of bands bands of sampleBytes bytes each are rewritten band-sequentially.

expectAll.description: A digest over the concatenation of every step's output, after unpack and deinterleave, for a vector whose steps are the strips or tiles of one image.
